data.name: SSH_AGENT_HOST_UNREACHABLE
data.value: No answer from the agent host and port: HostPanel has no network path to them. Check the address, that the network this HostPanel runs in reaches it (VPN or routing), and that the server's firewall lets HostPanel's address in.

data.name: SSH_AGENT_PORT_REFUSED
data.value: The agent host refused the connection on that port: nothing listens there, or a firewall rejects HostPanel's address. Check the port and the firewall.

data.name: SSH_AGENT_CONNECTION_CLOSED
data.value: The agent host accepted the connection and closed it before the SSH greeting: sshd is turning HostPanel's address away. On OpenSSH 9.8 or later this is usually PerSourcePenalties after failed or unauthenticated connections; add HostPanel's address to PerSourcePenaltyExemptList. Also check MaxStartups and TCP wrappers (hosts.deny).
